ValidationRule.description: If Lead Status is 'Qualified' and Number of Branches not zero then Branch office country and Branch Office City Is Required.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.Name ='Agent Acquisition', TEXT(Status)='Qualified', TEXT(Number_Of_Branches__c) !='0', OR( ISBLANK(Branch_Office_Country__c), ISBLANK( Branch_Office_City__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please provide Number of Branches, Branch Office Country and Branch Office City
